SURFACE: hammered red copper with verdigris edges, scratches and old dents, weathered opaque coarse cloth, dry old timber, painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Dark old wooden theatrical backstage, near abandoned percussion storage [nyubachi-bo-c03,c06]. Stage context editorial from instrument use, no temple iconography or writing.
MOOD: uncanny startling instrument-yokai, sudden metallic confrontation, never ordinary calm man, cute mascot or neutral portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, watermark, nudity, gore, extra limbs/digits, borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs, generic glowing aura, neon outlines, floating runes or energy ribbons.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and slapping-hand, reaching-hand, face, feet and background-shelf crops. One humanlike yokai (nyubachi-bo-c02) with one head and one deeply lined, grimacing face. It has two eyes (the left one shadowed under the brim) and crooked ordinary teeth, with no horns or fangs. A broad hammered copper percussion plate sits tilted on its head (c01/c02/c06), with a raised central boss, a verdigris rim and dents. The boss and the gongs racked behind make it read as a cymbal, not a straw hat. Two arms: the raised hand slaps the plate side-on, with four fingers visible and the thumb under the palm, and patina flakes and dust burst off the metal. The other hand lunges at the viewer, thumb plus four fingers. Two legs in cloth foot-wraps, one planted forward and one behind. The ragged dark robe is fully opaque. The setting is a dark wooden theatre backstage with percussion storage (a stage instrument, c03/c06), lit by one amber lamp. The startling-noise action follows the Heisei-era explanation (c04, modern popular culture), which the receipt labels as later. It is shown only as a physical slap, with no sound rings or aura. The low lunge, the clawing hand and the grimace under the cymbal make it an uncanny instrument-yokai attacking, strong at 200px, not an ordinary man in a hat. Hyotan-kozo is left out by choice. No text; original design.
